run_process_genarris_outputs_single: process Genarris output JSON files from a single conformer directory into deduplicated partitioned parquet format
run_process_genarris_outputs: batch process multiple Genarris output directories using SLURM parallel execution and save results as parquet files
run_structure_to_row: convert an ASE JSON structure dict to a standardized DataFrame row with CIF, formula, and partition data
run_get_pre_relax_filter_config: extract pre-relaxation filtering parameters like lattice tolerance, site tolerance, and partition count from workflow config
run_deduplicate_structures: deduplicate crystal structures in a DataFrame using lattice, site, and angle tolerance thresholds before ML relaxation
